entries.title: 1989: NASA launches Space Shuttle Discovery on STS-33, a classified mission for the United States Department of Defense.
entries.summary: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the United States' civil space program, as well as research in aeronautics and space.

entries.title: 1574: Spanish navigator Juan Fernández discovers islands now known as the Juan Fernández Islands off Chile.
entries.summary: Juan Fernández was a Spanish explorer and navigator in the Pacific regions of the Viceroyalty of Peru and Captaincy General of Chile west of colonial South America.

entries.title: 2004: The Orange Revolution begins in Ukraine, resulting from the presidential elections.
